meta.title: Catacombs & Starspawns source master
meta.description: Structured extraction of the four game-maker-maintained documents supplied on 2026-08-24.
meta.currentSourcePolicy: These are the complete current game-maker documents. A fact represented here must come from one of these four files, must appear only once in its authoritative form, and must not be filled from an earlier document.
meta.applicationBoundary: The documents define current source content, not the app's screen design. Existing Hunter creation, the canonical character sheet, saved-character compatibility, and table workflows remain while source-backed values and calculations are corrected underneath them.
meta.undefinedRulePolicy: When these documents name a field or external rule without defining its calculation or contents, record that gap instead of importing or inventing an answer.

sources.title: C&S Whispers Sheet
sources.description: The current two-page Whispers reference, containing six Whispers.

entries.name: Eldritch Rebuke
entries.performing: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself
entries.text: The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by blue flames and crackling lightning. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries.upgrade: Using a Higher-Level Strain. The damage increases by 1d10 for each Strain level above 1.

entries.name: Eldritch Chain of Bolts
entries.text: You invoke a Patron of storm and ruin, causing a beam of crackling lightning to lance toward a creature within range. Make a ranged Rite attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage. Until the Rite ends, you can take a Bonus Action on each of your turns to cause the lightning to surge through the target, dealing 1d12 Lightning damage automatically. The Rite ends if the target is ever outside the Rite's range or has Total Cover from you.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. The initial damage increases by 1d12 for each Strain level above 1.

entries.name: Darkness
entries.text: For the duration, otherworldly Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and light can't illuminate it.

entries.name: Armor of the Drowned Star
entries.text: You call upon a Patron of frozen ruin, wreathing your body in otherworldly frost. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these Temporary Hit Points, that creature takes 5 Cold damage. This Rite ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points remaining.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. The Temporary Hit Points and Cold damage both increase by 5 for each Strain level above 1.

entries.name: Shattered Reflection
entries.text: You call upon a Patron of fractured sight, causing three illusory duplicates of yourself to appear in your space. Until the Rite ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting constantly so it is impossible to know which image is real. Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the Rite's duration, roll a d6 for each duplicate you have remaining. If any of the d6s roll a 3 or higher, one duplicate is hit instead of you, and that duplicate is destroyed. The duplicates ignore all other damage and effects. The Rite ends early when all three duplicates are destroyed. A creature is unaffected by this Rite if it has the Blinded condition, Blindsight, or Truesight.

entries.name: Misty Step
entries.text: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You try not to fathom where you just passed through, suffer 3 Madness.

entries.name: Mindgrab
entries.text: By your words a patron will attach itself onto the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 Mind damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you also always know the target's location until the spell ends, but only while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. While you have this knowledge, the target can't become hidden from you, and if it has the Invisible condition, it gains no benefit from that condition against you.
entries.upgrade: Using a Higher-Level Strain. The damage increases by 1d8 for each Strain level above 2.

entries.name: Enthrall
entries.text: You word out forbidden truths gifted by a Patron whose words mortal minds struggle to comprehend. You suffer 2 Madness. Creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. A creature currently fighting you or your allies automatically succeeds on this saving throw. On a failed save, a creature becomes captivated by the impossible words and suffers a -10 penalty to Perception checks and Passive Perception until the Rite ends.

entries.name: Eldritch Cacophony
entries.text: You invoke a Patron of forbidden knowledge, flooding the minds of nearby creatures with fragments of truths they were never meant to comprehend. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 8d6 Mind damage, and its thoughts become muddled for 10 rounds. While muddled, it subtracts 1d6 from Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, and Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration. At the end of each of its turns, the creature may repeat the Intelligence saving throw, ending the muddled effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. If this Rite is performed with a Strain above Level 5, the damage increases by 2d6 for each Strain level above 5.

entries.name: Detect Eldritch Presence
entries.text: For the duration, you sense eldritch presence if any, within 30 feet of you. If you sense such a presence, you can take the Rite Action to learn its direction and approximate distance: Close, Away, or Far. If the presence is Close and was created by a Rite, you also learn the Rite's type.

entries.name: Eldritch Eye
entries.text: You call upon a Patron that sees through distance, flesh, and stone. Choose one creature on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, modified by how well you know the target and what physical connection you have to it. The target does not know what is watching it, only that something vast and unseen has turned its attention toward it. On a successful save, the target is not affected, and you can't perform this Rite on it again until after a Long Rest. On a failed save, the Patron opens an invisible, intangible eye within 10 feet of the target. For the duration, you can see and hear through the eye as if you were there. The eye moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it. If a creature can see the eye, it appears as a pale luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Save modifiers — You Have the Target's...
rows: Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail

entries.name: Arms of Hastur
entries.text: You invoke Yog-Sothoth, the Dark Hunger Between the Stars, causing writhing tendrils to erupt from your body and lash out at nearby creatures. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Acid damage and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. The damage increases by 1d6 for each Strain level above 1.

entries.name: Grasp of Yog-Sothoth
entries.text: You invoke Yog-Sothoth, the Dark Hunger Between the Stars, causing a massive black tendril to erupt from the ground beneath a creature you can see within range. The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and gains the Restrained condition. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects. At the end of each of its turns, a Restrained creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. The tendril remains in its space for the duration. If the tendril is not currently Restraining a creature, a creature that enters a space within 5 feet of it for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, must make the saving throw against this Rite. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and becomes Restrained by the tendril. If a creature dies while Restrained by the tendril, Yog-Sothoth claims its victim. The creature and everything it carries vanish into the void between the stars, and the Rite immediately ends.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. The damage increases by 1d6 for each Strain level above 2.

entries.name: Unknown Realm
entries.text: By your words an unknown realm will appear in a 30-foot Cube within range. The realm appears for a moment and then vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the realm must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 2 Madness, have the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0. The condition will remain for the duration or end for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

entries.name: Grasp of the Starless Deep
entries.text: You invoke something vast and nameless beyond the veil, tearing open a brief wound in the world through which writhing limbs of the outer dark reach forth. Squirming black tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground you can see within range. For the duration, the area is Difficult Terrain. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage and has the Restrained condition until the Rite ends. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't Restrained. A creature must also make this save when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn. A Restrained creature can take an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Rite save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.

entries.name: Call Lesser Starborn
entries.text: You invoke a Patron from beyond the stars, tearing open a fleeting breach in reality and calling forth one of its lesser servants. A Lesser Starborn manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The creature uses the Lesser Starborn stat block. The Lesser Starborn disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when this Rite ends. The Lesser Starborn is friendly to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count but takes its turn immediately after yours. The Lesser Starborn obeys your verbal commands (no Action required by you). If you issue no commands, it takes the Dodge Action and uses its movement to avoid danger. A Lesser Starborn is an unnatural creature of the outer dark. Its form varies according to the Patron that answered your call. Some resemble eyeless masses of flesh and tendrils, while others appear as twisted creatures stitched together from impossible anatomy and starlit void.
entries.upgrade: Using Higher-Level Strain. The Lesser Starborn gains 10 Temporary Hit Points for each Strain level above 5.

entries.name: True Seeing
entries.text: You call upon a Patron that will show you what mortal eyes were never meant to witness. For the duration, one willing creature you touch has Truesight with a range of 120 feet. The creature also suffers 4 Madness.

entries.name: Plane Shift
entries.text: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence…
entries.sourceNote: The supplied entry ends with an ellipsis and provides no further destination or resolution procedure.

entries.name: Mind Shatter
entries.text: You invoke a Patron of unfathomable power, suffer 3 Madness, unleashing a fragment of its eldritch knowledge into the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 10d12 Mind damage. For the next 10 rounds, the target can't perform Rites, and its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers become -5. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no additional effects.

entries.name: Foresight
entries.text: You call upon a Patron that peers beyond the veil of time and fate. By its guidance, a willing creature you touch is granted fleeting glimpses of the immediate future, allowing it to perceive danger moments before it occurs. For the duration, the target has Advantage on all D20 Tests, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it. This Rite ends early if you perform it again.

entries.name: Call Starborn Horror
entries.text: You tear open reality and call forth a true Starborn Horror, a servant of the outer dark that was never meant to enter the mortal world. When the Starborn Horror manifests, each creature within a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 Mind damage, suffers 10 Madness, and gains the Frightened condition for the duration. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers 5 Madness. Each other creature that can see or hear the Starborn Horror suffers 4 Madness. You suffer 10 Madness when you perform this Rite. The Starborn Horror uses the Starborn Horror stat block. It is not friendly to you or your allies, nor is it inherently hostile to your enemies. The Horror acts according to its own unknowable will. At the start of each of its turns, roll on the Starborn Horror Behavior Table to determine which action it takes. When determining targets, use your Madness die system. The Starborn Horror disappears when the Rite ends.

entries.name: Eldritch Blast
entries.text: You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged rite attack against one creature or object in range. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Eldritch Power damage.
entries.upgrade: Whisper Upgrade. The rite creates two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

entries.name: Eldritch Strike
entries.special: Special Requirements: A weapon with which you have proficiency
entries.text: Guided by your Patron's will, you make one attack with the weapon used to perform this Rite. The attack uses your Rite Performing ability for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity. If the attack deals damage, it can be Eldritch Power damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice).
entries.upgrade: Whisper Upgrade. Whether you deal Eldritch Power damage or the weapon's normal damage type, the attack deals extra Eldritch Power damage when you reach levels 5 (1d6), 11 (2d6), and 17 (3d6).

entries.name: Eldritch Lightning
entries.text: You call upon a Patron, letting a fragment of its voice burst from your body as crackling lightning. Each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Lightning damage. The Rite also makes a thunderous sound can be heard up to 100 feet away.
entries.upgrade: Whisper Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

entries.name: Mindcrack
entries.text: You try to temporarily break the mind of one creature you can see within range, opening their minds to the words of your patron through whispers. The target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or take 1d6 Mind damage and subtract 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
entries.upgrade: Whisper Upgrade. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach levels 5 (2d6), 11 (3d6), and 17 (4d6).

entries.name: Minor Illusion
entries.text: A patron will make a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you perform this rite again. If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your rites save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature. Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a roar, a beating of a heart, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends. Image. If you create an image of an object-such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest-it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

entries.name: Third Hand
entries.text: A spectral, floating hand not from this world appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you perform this rite again. When you perform the rite, you can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. As a Rite action on your later turns, you can control the hand thus again. As part of that action, you can move the hand up to 30 feet. The hand can't attack, or carry more than 10 pounds.

sourceCoverage.defined: The sheet defines the fields a hunter records, including ability scores, modifiers, saving throws, skills, vitals, equipment, class features, feats, Rite values, prepared Whispers, and notes.
notDefined: An ability-score generation method or point budget
The formula for an ability modifier, saving throw, skill value, Armor Class, Hit Points, Sanity, Initiative, Passive Perception, or Rite value
sourceCoverage.appPolicy: Keep the current character-creation and character-sheet workflow, accept ability scores directly, and never present an unspecified generation method as a current-source rule. Established calculations outside this source set must remain clearly separate from the structured source master.

hiddenConditionSheet.description: The supplied Pages document contains the current hidden rules for the Second Threshold, Old One Vessel, and Lost.
hiddenConditionSheet.publicPolicy: Do not include this source, its download, its text, its condition names, or its missing-source notes in the public Codex or other player-facing search and download surfaces.

sections.title: The Second Threshold
paragraphs: When an Insane hunter’s current Madness equals or exceeds twice their Max Sanity, the hunter is taken by the outer dark. The GM takes control of the character, and the character is replaced by an Old One Vessel stat block appropriate to the hunter’s level. All the Old One Vessel forms are listed in the Bestiary inside The C&S app under Player Alterations.
The Vessel is hostile to all creatures, including the party. It is not the hunter. It is something using the hunter as a wound through which to enter the world.

If the Vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the hunter returns with 1 Hit Point. Their current Madness becomes equal to their original Max Sanity, and their Max Sanity permanently becomes twice its original value.
If the same hunter becomes an Old One Vessel a second time, the hunter is lost forever.

sections.title: Old One Vessel Rules
paragraphs: When a hunter becomes an Old One Vessel, use the stat block matching the hunter’s level found in the Bestiary inside The C&S app under Player Alterations.

The Vessel replaces the hunter’s game statistics. It does not use the hunter’s weapons, armor, Rites, class features, feats, transformations, items, or proficiencies unless a rule specifically says otherwise.
The GM controls the Vessel. It is hostile to all creatures.

If the Vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the hunter returns with 1 Hit Point and the Old One Vessel Condition removed.. Their current Madness becomes equal to their original Max Sanity, and their Max Sanity permanently becomes twice its original value.
If the same hunter gains the Old One Vessel Condition  a second time, that hunter will have that condition permanently, and is practically removed as a player.

sections.title: Lost
paragraphs: If you roll Lost on the Transformation Table, you become a Lost: Greater Dreadblood. When a hunter becomes Lost, they transform into one of the Lost Dreadblood forms listed in the Bestiary inside The C&S app under Player Alterations. The GM controls the creature.

sections.title: Lost Rules
paragraphs: When a hunter becomes Lost, use the stat block matching the hunter’s level found in the Bestiary inside The C&S app under Player Alterations.

The Lost replaces the hunter’s game statistics. It does not use the hunter’s weapons, armor, Rites, class features, feats, transformations, items, or proficiencies unless a rule specifically says otherwise.
The GM controls the Lost. It is hostile to all creatures.
If the Lost is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the hunter returns with 1 Hit Point and the Lost Condition removed, and gains 10 + 2d4 Madness minus the players wisdom, modifier.

appIntegration.supported: Track current Sanity, current Madness, and the existing Insane marker without publishing the hidden outcomes.
appIntegration.madnessTracking: Current Madness is an explicit value in this source. The supplied documents do not define it as Max Sanity minus current Sanity, so the app must track it independently instead of inferring it or representing it through negative Sanity.
appIntegration.notAutomated: Do not replace a hunter with an Old One Vessel or Lost form until the referenced level-matched stat blocks are supplied. Never invent those statistics.
